thread:
Ravi Shah: Noticed weirdness in quotas dashboard. Rapid org hops show another org's usage for a split second. Repro: click org switcher twice fast.
Priya Menon: omg seeing this too. Happened during last console canary. Could be cache key collision between prefetch and live render.
Ethan Cole: quick check: logs show `cache.get(key=panel:quota:range=30d)` hit immediately after a request with `x-org-id` different.
Ravi Shah: policy-wise, we should enforce namespace scoping at cache boundary. Any cache key must include tenant id.
Priya Menon: agree. Also add guardrail in proxy to drop `x-internal-route` so we don't accidentally include internal route hints in keys.
deploy-bot: console canary 1.13.0 rolled at 2026-03-21T11:00:00Z to 20%.
telemetry-bot: added metric `console.cache.mismatch` alerted at 2026-03-21T11:02Z.
Ravi Shah: immediate plan: 1) disable panel caching for quota panels 2) patch cache key builder to include tenant 3) add unit + harness test 4) notify SOC.
Priya Menon: I'll open INC-3301 and draft support note.
Ethan Cole: PR: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/802 (includes tests).
Ravi Shah: let's coordinate hotfix and rollback plan.
Priya Menon: filing INC-3301 now.
Ravi Shah: thanks, keep thread updated.
